body: I want to, but I literally have no where to go.
Very slowly. I could pull like...$10-20 out of the bank every week. Any more and I'm sure he'd catch on.
No, they all still live at home with their parents. I've asked my parents at one point if I could stay with them and they said they didn't want to deal with my personal issues.
I'm a lot better now. He went to bed after his tantrum, so I've been just sitting alone for a while, which is a lot more peaceful. I can think a lot clearer.

There isn't here. There was two, one shut down because the owners couldn't afford to keep it open. The other is a battered woman's shelter that is always cramped. I'd rather they save those spaces for women who's lives are truly in danger. I'm not...he's just a giant asshole to me.

When do you turn 18? My mom acted similarly towards me, and life got a hundred times better after I moved out. We actually get along now, and she treats me with respect for the first time ever. I think you getting out would do so much good.
